predictions.articleTitle: Marino vs Tenerife C Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Home Defense Halt Youthful Attack?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Marino's superior 1.20 goals-conceded baseline and regular match rhythm support a Home Win / Draw call in an open Over 2.5 contest led by a 2:1 home victory.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw backed by Marino's 42.5% Poisson win share and 1.20 GA/gm defensive edge while covering a 1:1 draw threat (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 goals anchored by a 3.27 combined lambda total and 63.4% Poisson Over 2.5 expectancy (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle: 1:1 Draw cushion if Tenerife C's rested youth core contains the first hour and mirrors Marino's back-to-back 1:1 stalemates (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Marino's steadier home defense tests Tenerife C's 1.89 goals-per-game youth attack.

spf.comment: Covers both the primary 2:1 Marino victory and the 1:1 draw branch because Tenerife C's 1.89 goals-per-game attack prevents relying on a single home win.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.27 combined statistical lambda, 63.4% Poisson Over 2.5 distribution, and Tenerife C's 1.89 scored / 1.67 conceded per-match averages.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Marino's home attacking edge against a 1.67 GA/gm defense with both teams scoring, while 1:1 captures the top Poisson density and Marino's recent draw streak.

goals.comment: Aligns directly with the top two Poisson total-goal buckets (22.1% for 3 goals, 20.3% for 2 goals) and the 2:1 and 1:1 scoreline scripts.

bqc.comment: Projects a competitive, level first half before either Marino's weekly rhythm breaks the deadlock after halftime or both sides share points at 1:1.
